analogy.rationale: COX inhibitors block prostaglandin synthesis, but these cell lines are transformed lines with low baseline inflammatory signaling, so transcriptional changes are modest; the closest responses come from other arachidonic-acid-pathway modulators (lipoxygenase inhibitors, prostanoid antagonists) and anti-inflammatory agents, with PPAR and phospholipase classes sharing some target overlap.
